vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The company must achieve a closing bid price at or above US$1.00 for 10 consecutive business days to regain compliance. The extension does not affect current trading or operations, and the company indicated it may pursue a reverse stock split if necessary to meet the requirement.

top.title: ISRG's da Vinci Study Shows Better Outcomes Across 13 Common Conditions

top.summary: Lennar reported $8.05 billion in revenue for Q3 2026, down 8.7% year-over-year and missing consensus estimates by 3.44%. EPS of $1.23 fell short of the $1.29 estimate. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating.

top.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Lennar  and Wayfair
top.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates by 25 basis points on Wednesday for the first time since July 2023, with a 93% probability priced in by futures markets. This decision, combined with August retail sales data and Thursday's housing starts/permits report, creates significant market volatility. An unprecedented scenario could unfold if Chair Kevin Warsh opposes the hike while the committee votes to raise rates—the first time in Fed history a sitting chair could be outvoted on monetary policy. Homebuilder Lennar and online retailer Wayfair are key stocks to watch as they face headwinds from rising borrowing costs.

An unprecedented scenario could unfold if Chair Kevin Warsh opposes the hike while the committee votes to proceed—the first time in Fed history the FOMC would outvote a sitting chair. Key economic data on retail sales, housing starts, and building permits will provide context for the decision.

top.title: ACLS Invests $35M in Korea To Expand Its Manufacturing Infrastructure
top.summary: Axcelis Technologies plans to invest $35 million in a new 200,000-square-foot ion implantation facility in South Korea to expand manufacturing capacity and improve customer responsiveness. The investment comes as South Korea now represents 26% of quarterly revenues and bookings increased 36.1% year-over-year. However, the company faces challenges with declining backlog (down 21.6% YoY) and compressed margins, with management expecting only slight improvement ahead.

top.title: AMAT vs. LRCX: Which WFE Stock is a Safer Bet Right Now?
top.summary: Applied Materials (AMAT) and Lam Research (LRCX) are compared as investment picks in the wafer fabrication equipment market. AMAT benefits from AI-driven demand across foundry-logic, DRAM, and advanced packaging, with strong revenue growth and a broader portfolio. LRCX also benefits from AI investment but faces material risks from China trade restrictions, which accounted for 26% of recent revenues. Both stocks carry Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) ratings, though AMAT is positioned as the safer pick due to its diversified portfolio.

top.title: KLA Stock Jumps 40% Year to Date: 4 Reasons You Should Still Buy It
top.summary: KLA Corporation (KLAC) has gained 40% year-to-date, driven by AI-related process-control intensity and advanced packaging expansion. The company expects advanced-packaging revenues to reach $1.1 billion in 2026 (70% growth) with a strong $12.6 billion backlog providing visibility through 2027. Despite premium valuation and near-term margin pressure from memory costs and tariffs, KLA's technology leadership and long-term growth outlook support a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

top.title: Visa vs. Mastercard: Which Payment Stock Has More Upside?
top.summary: Visa and Mastercard both benefit from the secular shift toward digital payments and cross-border transactions. While Visa shows strong value-added services growth (34% YoY) and expanding AI-driven services, Mastercard demonstrates faster EPS growth expectations (16.8% vs 14.7%), higher value-added services revenue contribution (41.2% of total), and strategic advantages through its Agent Pay platform and BVNK acquisition. Mastercard is rated as the more attractive opportunity despite both stocks carrying a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

top.title: Visa Finds Online Spending Gaining Ground Across Key Markets
top.summary: Visa reports that the 'couch economy'—home-centered spending on online shopping, streaming, food delivery, and subscriptions—has become a lasting consumer behavior trend. U.S. online and in-app payment volume reached 58% in 2026 from 48% in 2019. This shift benefits payment processors through increased digital transaction volumes and recurring spending, though Visa trades at a premium valuation of 25.18X forward P/E versus the industry average of 17.69X and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

top.title: Visa Stock Offers Growth, but is it Worth Buying at 24.9X Forward P/E?
top.summary: Visa trades at 24.87X forward earnings, above industry average but below its five-year median. While the company demonstrates strong margins (54.1%), expanding Value-Added Services ($3.8B in Q3), and solid cash generation ($15.2B free cash flow YTD), its premium valuation, rising competition from fintech alternatives, and regulatory pressures limit near-term upside. Analysts see 14.7% upside potential, but the stock is rated Hold as much growth is already priced in.

top.title: PayPal's Agentic Payments: Can These Unlock the Next Growth Leg?
top.summary: PayPal is investing in agentic payments as a potential long-term growth driver from 2028 onward, leveraging its wallet, merchant network, and identity capabilities. While not a near-term earnings catalyst, the company aims to capture more AI-driven commerce transactions. Competitors Visa and Mastercard are also advancing similar agentic commerce platforms. PayPal shares have gained 26.5% in three months and trade at a significant valuation discount.

top.title: Immunocore Hits Enrollment Target in Kimmtrak Label Expansion Study
top.summary: Immunocore announced it has enrolled 540 patients in the phase III TEBE-AM study evaluating Kimmtrak as monotherapy and in combination with Merck's Keytruda versus investigator's choice in previously treated advanced melanoma. The company expects top-line overall survival data as early as end of 2026. Kimmtrak sales grew 16% year-over-year to $222.6 million in the first half of 2026.

top.title: Is Cancer the Turnaround Moderna Has Been Looking for Post-COVID?
top.summary: Moderna reported positive Phase III results for its personalized mRNA cancer therapy (intismeran autogene) developed with Merck, showing significant improvements in recurrence-free and distant metastasis-free survival in melanoma patients. The breakthrough validates Moderna's mRNA platform beyond vaccines and opens opportunities across multiple tumor types, while the company simultaneously expands its respiratory vaccine portfolio with RSV, flu, and combination vaccines to reduce COVID-19 dependence.

top.title: Immunotherapy Drugs Market 2026: Precision Medicine, Next-Generation Biologics and Expanding Cancer Indications Fuel Growth Opportunities
top.summary: The global immunotherapy drugs market is experiencing significant growth driven by advances in biotechnology, rising demand for targeted treatments, and expanding therapeutic applications across cancer, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. Key growth factors include increasing disease burden, robust drug pipelines, personalized medicine adoption, and combination therapy development. The Americas and Europe remain dominant markets, while Asia-Pacific is emerging as a high-growth region. Major pharmaceutical and biotech companies are increasing R&D investments and collaboration to accelerate innovation.

top.title: Parexel to Lead Sessions at DPHARM 2026 on AI, Talent and the Future of Clinical Operations
top.summary: Parexel announced it will lead three expert panel sessions at DPHARM 2026 in Boston on enterprise AI adoption, workforce readiness, and patient-centric drug development. The company showcased its proprietary ParexelAI suite, which has delivered significant efficiency gains including 50% reduction in site selection timelines, 30% reduction in clinical study report preparation time, and 60% reduction in safety literature screening. CEO Peyton Howell and other executives will moderate discussions with leaders from major pharmaceutical companies including AbbVie, AstraZeneca, Boehringer Ingelheim, Regeneron, and Merck.

top.title: Credo Powers AI Networks With New 1.6T ZeroFlap Optics Launch
top.summary: Credo Technology Group launched its new 224G ZeroFlap optical transceivers supporting 1.6T port speeds for AI architectures. The products integrate DSPs with silicon photonics PICs to reduce insertion loss and improve link margin. Credo expects optical revenue above $600 million in fiscal 2027 with over 85% full-year revenue growth, though it faces intense competition from Marvell Technology and Astera Labs in the high-speed optical networking market.

top.title: ALAB Broadens Leo Portfolio: Can It Stay Ahead of MRVL & CRDO?
top.summary: Astera Labs (ALAB) has expanded its Leo Smart Memory Controller portfolio with new X-Series and Leo 2 E/P Series products targeting agentic AI and cloud workloads. The company reported record Q2 2026 revenue growth and expects Q3 revenues between $540-560 million, representing ~40% sequential growth. ALAB faces competition from Marvell Technology and Credo Technology in the AI connectivity space.

top.title: Credo (CRDO) vs. Marvell (MRVL): Which AI Chip Stock Is the Better Buy?
top.summary: Credo Technology and Marvell Technology are compared as AI chip investment options. Credo offers faster near-term growth (87% revenue growth projected for FY2027) with better valuation at 30X forward earnings, but faces concentration risk with 4 customers representing 84% of revenue. Marvell provides broader AI infrastructure exposure with stronger long-term earnings growth but trades at a premium 72X multiple. Both stocks receive a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

top.title: All Eyes Set on September FOMC Meet
top.summary: Major indexes opened lower Monday amid concerns over unregulated AI development and escalating Middle East tensions. AI chip makers like Marvell and AMD fell over 6%, while software security firms gained. Oil prices surged 4% to $104/bbl on geopolitical risks. The FOMC meets Tuesday-Wednesday with an 80% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike, supported by elevated 10-year bond yields near 5%.

top.title: CAR T-Cell Therapy for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Market Set for Strong Growth Through 2036, Driven by Next-Generation Innovation and Expanding Patient Access

Key challenges include relapse rates, manufacturing complexity, and toxicity management, while opportunities exist in earlier treatment lines and off-the-shelf platforms.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +20.0 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +20.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

top.title: PRCT 6-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Investors Alerted to September 22, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline in Class Action Lawsuit
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against PROCEPT BioRobotics for allegedly misleading investors about handpiece sales performance. The company allegedly used undisclosed bulk order discount programs to artificially inflate sales figures by pulling forward future quarter sales, resulting in excess customer inventory exceeding 10,000 units. The stock declined over 48% from August 2025 to February 2026 as the truth emerged through quarterly earnings misses and management disclosures.

top.title: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Inventory Issues and approximately 18% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq, at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
top.summary: PROCEPT BioRobotics faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit for failing to disclose material inventory issues. The company revealed that handpiece sales had materially exceeded procedures since Q1 2023, resulting in over 10,000 units of excess field inventory. This disclosure caused the stock to decline 18% in two days, from $27.84 to $22.69 per share, as quarterly handpiece sales dropped nearly 30% and the company missed annual revenue guidance by tens of millions of dollars. Investors have until September 22, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

top.summary: IonQ presented nine peer-reviewed papers at the IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE26) in Toronto, winning four Best Paper Awards out of 857 global submissions. top.title: Rising Expenses Weigh on QUBT's Profit: Hold or Sell QUBT Stock Now?
top.summary: Quantum Computing Inc. (QUBT) faces profitability challenges despite strong revenue growth, with Q2 2026 revenues jumping to $5.6M and a $42.5M contract backlog. However, operating expenses of $21.8M (3.5X revenues) and a net loss of $11.8M highlight the company's struggle to convert growth into profitability. With a strong $1.3B cash position and diversified technology portfolio, QUBT maintains high-risk, high-potential status. Zacks rates it a Hold, recommending current holders maintain positions while prospective investors await better entry points.

top.summary: Product liability litigation in federal courts reached a ten-year high in 2025, driven primarily by vehicle warranty cases which surged 269% since 2016. California's federal courts, particularly the Central District, accounted for over one-third of national product liability filings, with Los Angeles Superior Court seeing dramatic increases in auto warranty cases under the Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act.

top.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Replimune Group, Inc. following the FDA's rejection of the company's Biologics License Application for RP1 in combination with nivolumab on April 10, 2026. The FDA cited deficiencies in clinical studies and stated the evidence did not meet approval standards. The stock price fell 19.46% on the announcement and an additional 64.29% days later, totaling an 83.75% decline from $4.76 to $1.70 per share. Investors who purchased securities during the class period have until October 5, 2026, to request Lead Plaintiff status.

top.title: REPL Shareholder Alert: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Replimune Group, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Levi & Korsinsky
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Replimune Group, Inc. for allegedly failing to disclose regulatory concerns about its RP1 trial design to shareholders. The lawsuit claims the company built its regulatory strategy around single-arm trial designs that the FDA had already questioned, including response criteria inconsistent with RECIST v1.1 standards. Investors who purchased REPL shares between October 20, 2025 and April 10, 2026 experienced significant losses, with the stock declining 84.16% during the class period.

top.summary: TJX Companies raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.15-$5.20 following strong Q2 results that exceeded expectations. top.title: TJX Falls 17.4% in the Past Month as Strong Results Meet Key Risks

The company faces headwinds from higher wage and fuel costs, and its valuation premium leaves limited room for error.

top.title: Should Investors Buy TJX as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays Rich?

Key risks include Marmaxx underperformance and rising cost pressures, though strong cash generation supports growth and shareholder returns.

top.title: TJX International's Adjusted Margin Hits 7.3%: More Upside Ahead?

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: zSpace, Inc. Announces Intention to Voluntarily Delist from Nasdaq and Deregister Its Common Stock with the SEC
top.summary: zSpace, Inc. announced its intention to voluntarily delist from Nasdaq and deregister its common stock with the SEC. The company's trading on Nasdaq has been suspended since April 2026 following a delisting determination, and its appeal was denied in August 2026. The company plans to file a Form 25 on September 25, 2026, with delisting expected to become effective around October 5, 2026, and deregistration around December 24, 2026. The stock will continue trading on the OTC market under the symbol ZSPC.

top.title: Experiencing New Changes in AI Applications at CIFTIS
top.summary: At the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services in Beijing, AI technology is being integrated into core business processes across multiple sectors. Companies like Feixiang Xingqiu are using AI to automate teaching material creation, Meituan is deploying AI agents for merchant operations and customer feedback analysis, and ZTO Express has deployed over 3,500 unmanned delivery vehicles across 260+ cities. Nearly 40% of showcased cases feature AI as core technology, signaling a shift from isolated applications to systematic, platform-based AI development.
